question: Who won the 2025 Australian Open Men's Singles title?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jannik Sinner**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jannik Sinner**, the top-seeded **Italian** tennis professional, successfully clinched the **2025 Australian Open** Men's Singles title.
 
• The final match took place on **January 26, 2025**, at the prestigious **Rod Laver Arena** located within **Melbourne Park**, **Australia**.
 
• Sinner defeated the **German** player **Alexander Zverev** in a highly competitive final to secure the championship.
 
• This victory represents Sinner's **second consecutive** Australian Open title, following his first-ever Grand Slam win at the same tournament in **2024**.
 
• With this win, **Jannik Sinner** reinforced his position as the **World No. 1** in the ATP (Association of Tennis Professionals)
